verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins ships digital tools through LathamDrive, including a document generator, mobile glossary apps and the Automated Convertible Note, so asking whether it offers an official CLI is a fair question. However, no evidence shows any command-line interface. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, suggesting no developer-facing surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
